hooks.name: Format & lint on TS save
hooks.description: On saving a .ts/.tsx file, format it with Prettier and run ESLint on just that file. Does not modify other files or loop.

action.command: npx prettier --write "$KIRO_FILE_PATH" >/dev/null 2>&1; npx eslint "$KIRO_FILE_PATH" 2>&1 | tail -20 || true
